title: Nuclear Posture Review and the motive to discredit witnesses

tellings.quote: nuclear deterrence is the backbone the basis of our national security.

plain: A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas argues that the military had a reason to discredit people who saw UFOs at nuclear sites, since admitting they could not be stopped would undercut nuclear deterrence. He points to the Nuclear Posture Review, a Defense Department policy document, which he quotes as saying "nuclear deterrence is the backbone, the basis of our national security." The quoted line speaks to how much the Pentagon relies on deterrence; that this created a motive to discredit witnesses is Salas's own reading, which the line neither states nor rules out.
